tui.projects.send.empty.note: Empty linked-target picker; keep esc and /project link literal because they are executable controls. Single row; wraps only as existing widget permits.

tui.projects.send.no_match.note: Filtered-empty picker; backspace names the existing keyboard control, not a project-link failure. Single row.

tui.projects.send.compose.note: Recipient composer strip; handle is the already displayed short session identifier. Keep esc literal; one clipped line.

tui.projects.send.pending.note: In-flight composer receipt; handle is the selected recipient, ellipsis signals pending, not successful delivery. One line.

tui.projects.send.sent.note: Completed band receipt; handle and state_word are opaque identity and upstream delivery vocabulary, not parsed English. One line.

tui.projects.send.wake_unconfirmed.note: Amber caution; do not remove resend warning. Notice fits a 56-cell narrow box, may truncate.

tui.projects.send.delivery_unconfirmed.note: Amber caution; directs transcript verification rather than resending. Notice fits a 56-cell narrow box.

tui.projects.send.fault.note: Local failure notice, distinct from delivery refusal; preserve retry action within 56 cells.

tui.projects.send.refusal.note: Delivery refusal; reason is opaque upstream text, never parse it. Handle omitted to preserve reason in 56-cell box.

tui.projects.send.error.note: Pre-delivery error; reason is opaque upstream text. Handle omitted to preserve reason in 56-cell box.

tui.projects.send.session.note: Target-row identity fallback; short is an opaque 12-cell session identifier. Used both in row and measured tail budget.

tui.projects.send.title.note: Picker title; short lowercase label, no recipient duplicated here.

tui.projects.send.filter.note: Input placeholder; short instruction, no key binding introduced.

tui.projects.send.legend.note: Picker grammar; preserve ↑↓, ↵ and esc as working controls. Fixed chrome row, no new interaction.

tui.projects.send.more.note: Hidden-row count; count selects the plural; label is its preformatted ASCII integer string, deliberately ungrouped to preserve English bytes. Identical English plural branches deliberately retain original noun-less copy.

tui.projects.send.binding_move.note: Textual binding description for existing up/down action; one short word.

tui.projects.send.binding_choose.note: Textual binding description for existing Enter action; one short word.

tui.projects.send.binding_close.note: Textual binding description for existing Escape action; one short word.

tui.projects.detail.no_text.note: Drawn in place of a project update entry whose body is empty after clamping, so the row exists and reads as an explicit absence rather than a blank gap. Parentheses are part of the value, matching the '(unnamed)' convention in this catalogue. One dim no-wrap line. EN-only until an independent translation/audit wave carries this namespace; fallback must not change locale eligibility.

tui.projects.detail.no_description.note: Drawn in place of a project description when the record has none (empty or whitespace-only), so the detail page's description section reads as an explicit absence rather than a blank gap. One dim no-wrap line. EN-only until an independent translation/audit wave carries this namespace; fallback must not change locale eligibility.

tui.projects.title.note: Shared lowercase title word across canvas, form and detail. One clipped title row; keep short.

tui.projects.new_project.note: Form title suffix including leading space and middle-dot separator; one clipped row.

tui.projects.active_view.note: Canvas title suffix; view is the localized display name, never the routing token. Preserve separator and one-row budget.

tui.projects.tracked.note: Tracked-project count in title; count is preformatted ASCII integer text to preserve existing ungrouped bytes. No English singular/other branch exists. One clipped clause.

tui.projects.zoom.note: Timeline-only title clause; tier is the opaque renderer tier token, not translated here. Leading separator and one-row budget.

tui.projects.updated.note: Shared canvas/detail freshness suffix; stamp retains existing local strftime %H:%M exactly. Do not reinterpret as relative time; one clipped clause.

tui.projects.this_session.note: Optional calling-session association count; count is preformatted ASCII integer text. Keep parentheses and separator; sheds first when title is narrow.

tui.projects.view_list.note: Human display name for stable list token; lowercase inside title, not routing vocabulary. One short word.

tui.projects.view_board.note: Human display name for stable board token; lowercase inside title, not routing vocabulary. One short word.

tui.projects.view_timeline.note: Human display name for stable timeline token; lowercase inside title, not routing vocabulary. One short word.

tui.projects.unnamed.note: Detail title fallback when project has no display name; preserve parentheses and keep short within one clipped row.

tui.projects.binding_show_list.note: Textual binding description for existing show_list action; key and action remain stable. Short help label, unchanged interaction; no wrapping guarantee.

tui.projects.binding_show_board.note: Textual binding description for existing show_board action; key and action remain stable. Short help label, unchanged interaction; no wrapping guarantee.

tui.projects.binding_show_timeline.note: Textual binding description for existing show_timeline action; key and action remain stable. Short help label, unchanged interaction; no wrapping guarantee.

tui.projects.binding_cycle_view.note: Textual binding description for existing cycle_view action; key and action remain stable. Short help label, unchanged interaction; no wrapping guarantee.

tui.projects.binding_open_detail.note: Textual binding description for existing open_detail action; key and action remain stable. Short help label, unchanged interaction; no wrapping guarantee.

tui.projects.binding_create.note: Textual binding description for existing create action; key and action remain stable. Short help label, unchanged interaction; no wrapping guarantee.

tui.projects.binding_message.note: Textual binding description for existing message action; key and action remain stable. Short help label, unchanged interaction; no wrapping guarantee.

tui.projects.binding_start.note: Textual binding description for existing start action; key and action remain stable. Short help label, unchanged interaction; no wrapping guarantee.

tui.projects.binding_copy_attachment.note: Textual binding description for existing copy_attachment action; key and action remain stable. Short help label, unchanged interaction; no wrapping guarantee.

tui.projects.binding_preview_attachment.note: Textual binding description for existing preview_attachment action; key and action remain stable. Short help label, unchanged interaction; no wrapping guarantee.

tui.projects.binding_refresh.note: Textual binding description for existing refresh action; key and action remain stable. Short help label, unchanged interaction; no wrapping guarantee.

tui.projects.binding_zoom_in.note: Textual binding description for existing zoom_in action; key and action remain stable. Short help label, unchanged interaction; no wrapping guarantee.

tui.projects.binding_zoom_out.note: Textual binding description for existing zoom_out action; key and action remain stable. Short help label, unchanged interaction; no wrapping guarantee.

tui.projects.binding_up.note: Textual binding description for existing up action; key and action remain stable. Short help label, unchanged interaction; no wrapping guarantee.

tui.projects.binding_down.note: Textual binding description for existing down action; key and action remain stable. Short help label, unchanged interaction; no wrapping guarantee.

tui.projects.binding_scroll_left.note: Textual binding description for existing scroll_left action; key and action remain stable. Short help label, unchanged interaction; no wrapping guarantee.

tui.projects.binding_scroll_right.note: Textual binding description for existing scroll_right action; key and action remain stable. Short help label, unchanged interaction; no wrapping guarantee.

tui.projects.binding_page_up.note: Textual binding description for existing page_up action; key and action remain stable. Short help label, unchanged interaction; no wrapping guarantee.

tui.projects.binding_page_down.note: Textual binding description for existing page_down action; key and action remain stable. Short help label, unchanged interaction; no wrapping guarantee.

tui.projects.binding_page_left.note: Textual binding description for existing page_left action; key and action remain stable. Short help label, unchanged interaction; no wrapping guarantee.

tui.projects.binding_page_right.note: Textual binding description for existing page_right action; key and action remain stable. Short help label, unchanged interaction; no wrapping guarantee.

tui.projects.binding_scroll_home.note: Textual binding description for existing scroll_home action; key and action remain stable. Short help label, unchanged interaction; no wrapping guarantee.

tui.projects.binding_scroll_end.note: Textual binding description for existing scroll_end action; key and action remain stable. Short help label, unchanged interaction; no wrapping guarantee.

tui.projects.binding_jump.note: Textual binding description for existing jump action; key and action remain stable. Short help label, unchanged interaction; no wrapping guarantee.

tui.projects.binding_next_section.note: Textual binding description for existing next_section action; key and action remain stable. Short help label, unchanged interaction; no wrapping guarantee.

tui.projects.binding_prev_section.note: Textual binding description for existing prev_section action; key and action remain stable. Short help label, unchanged interaction; no wrapping guarantee.

tui.projects.binding_leave.note: Textual binding description for existing leave action; key and action remain stable. Short help label, unchanged interaction; no wrapping guarantee.

tui.projects.form.title_placeholder.note: Placeholder of the project form's title field, shown only while the field is empty: the title is the human-readable name people read, as opposed to the reference key beside it. Lowercase fragment, not a sentence; keep it short enough for the field at narrow widths. EN-only until an independent translation/audit wave carries this namespace; fallback must not change locale eligibility.

tui.projects.form.key_placeholder.note: Placeholder of the project form's key field, shown only while empty: the key is the stable reference handle everything else points at (and follows the title until edited by hand). Lowercase fragment, not a sentence. EN-only until an independent translation/audit wave carries this namespace; fallback must not change locale eligibility.

tui.projects.form.tags_placeholder.note: Placeholder of the project form's tags field: it states the two accepted separators so the reader does not guess at a format the store would refuse. Lowercase fragment, not a sentence. EN-only until an independent translation/audit wave carries this namespace; fallback must not change locale eligibility.

tui.projects.form.team_placeholder.note: Placeholder of the project form's team field: the single word naming what belongs in the field (a team name). One word, lowercase; keep it that short. EN-only until an independent translation/audit wave carries this namespace; fallback must not change locale eligibility.

tui.projects.form.owner_placeholder.note: Placeholder of the project form's owner field: the single word naming what belongs in the field (the owning person). One word, lowercase; keep it that short. EN-only until an independent translation/audit wave carries this namespace; fallback must not change locale eligibility.

tui.projects.form.date_placeholder.note: Placeholder of BOTH date fields in the project form (target date and start date): the one accepted date spelling, ISO year-month-day with zero padding. This is a FORMAT TOKEN the store parses, not prose — keep the exact YYYY-MM-DD shape and digits layout in every locale so the hint always matches what validates. EN-only until an independent translation/audit wave carries this namespace; fallback must not change locale eligibility.

tui.projects.form.estimate_placeholder.note: Placeholder of the project form's estimate field: it names the default estimate unit (points; the adjacent cycle row offers the unit choices). One lowercase word matching the unit vocabulary the store accepts — if the unit words are ever translated, this must move with them. EN-only until an independent translation/audit wave carries this namespace; fallback must not change locale eligibility.

tui.projects.form.readback_hint.note: One row of the form's plain-text readback (the surface tests and geometry probes assert), restating a field's hint: '{label} hint: {hint}'. {label} is the field's short internal name and {hint} is the already-rendered hint text; both are kept verbatim, and the colon-space layout is part of the readback contract other assertions prefix-match on, so keep the shape. EN-only until an independent translation/audit wave carries this namespace; fallback must not change locale eligibility.

tui.projects.form.readback_error.note: One row of the form's plain-text readback (the surface tests and geometry probes assert), restating a field's refusal: '{label} error: {error}'. {label} is the field's short internal name and {error} is the already-rendered refusal sentence; both are kept verbatim, and tests prefix-match rows on '{label} error:', so keep the shape exactly. EN-only until an independent translation/audit wave carries this namespace; fallback must not change locale eligibility.

tui.projects.render.more_not_shown_inden.note: Indented overflow row on the board; the indent differs from its Text sibling below, so it is its own key.

tui.projects.render.more_not_shown.note: Unindented overflow row for the same fact; raw digit.

tui.projects.render.no_estimate_or_dates.note: Shown when a project carries neither an estimate nor dates; reused at both call sites so the two cannot drift.

tui.projects.render.no_progress.note: The short form used in a card's fact row; distinct from no_progress_recorded, which is the detail page's fuller sentence.

tui.projects.render.reported_ago.note: Age of the last progress report; suffix carries a parenthetical built in code, and the age is already humanised.

tui.projects.render.live_count.note: Number of live sessions attached; raw digit.

tui.projects.render.no_dates_count.note: Header of the undated-items tail; the count is the list length and the trailing colon and space introduce what follows.

tui.projects.render.no_dates_label.note: Same tail when a section label is known; the label is a section name from the data, not copy.

tui.projects.render.progress_none.note: Detail-page progress row when the record is empty; the colon is the label/value separator.

tui.projects.render.progress_reported.note: Detail-page progress row; suffix carries the reporter/staleness/refresh clauses built in code, then the colon introduces the value.

tui.projects.render.no_linked_sessions.note: Shown when a project has no linked sessions.

tui.projects.render.working_prefix.note: Label introducing the working-session list; the trailing space is layout.

tui.projects.render.session_missing.note: A linked session that is no longer on the ledger; the bracket is part of the marker and the identifier stays untranslated.

tui.projects.render.more_working.note: Overflow for the working list; leading separator and raw digit.

tui.projects.render.filed_by.note: Sessions that filed items; ids are identifiers and more is an overflow clause built in code.

tui.projects.render.no_progress_recorded.note: The detail page's fuller empty state; its own key because it reads as a sentence where no_progress reads as a value.

tui.projects.render.running_settled.note: Running/settled todo counts; both digits are raw.

tui.projects.render.own_session.note: Stands in for a session identifier when the row is the reader's own session.

tui.projects.render.open_over_total.note: Open-over-total counts on the detail page; raw digits and the spaced slash are layout.

tui.projects.render.next_clause.note: Names the next milestone; the leading em dash and space attach it to the row it follows.

tui.projects.render.todo_snapshots_none.note: Shown when no todo snapshots exist for the project.

tui.projects.render.more_lines_hint.note: The feed's expansion affordance; the brackets, the count and the return symbol are all part of the hint, and the noun/verb words are built in code (recorded as the next tranche).

tui.projects.render.older_updates.note: Trailing row for the render cap; raw digit.
